query: begin read only; select jsonb_build_object('observed_at',clock_timestamp(),'migration_count',(select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'latest_migration',(select jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version desc limit 1),'wave4_tables',jsonb_build_object('employees',to_regclass('people.employees'),'calendars',to_regclass('people.work_calendar_versions'),'private_hr',to_regclass('people_private.profiles'),'payroll',to_regclass('people_payroll.runs'),'projects',to_regclass('projects.register'),'service',to_regclass('service.equipment'),'assets',to_regclass('assets.register')),'synthetic_tenant_count',(select count(*) from core.tenants where slug='w4-employee-synthetic'),'worker_readiness_count',(select count(*) from people_private.worker_readiness),'finance_helpers',(select jsonb_object_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='finance' and p.proname in('flow_residual','wave3_lock_open_period','flow_post_journal','flow_allocate'))) evidence; rollback;
